result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a major vertical misalignment of the middle card in the Fastest near you carousel and minor truncation of the third restaurant name.

issues.description: Middle card 'Smash Bros Burgers' in 'Fastest near you' carousel is vertically misaligned - its image starts lower than the adjacent 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol' cards
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the same top baseline with equal image height and consistent spacing

issues.description: Third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Allow full name to show on scroll or truncate with ellipsis and ensure adequate card width
